about.storyP1: LetHim Voice is here for one simple reason: to make your everyday work a little easier.
about.storyP2: It started as an idea between two people who just wanted to work faster. We built it to speed up our own daily routine — and it helped so much that keeping it to ourselves felt wrong. So we are sharing it openly with the community, in Beta, to be tried, tested, and shaped by your feedback. It will keep growing and getting better.

guide.offlineDesc: No account, your voice never leaves this PC. The models download once (up to 5 GB).
guide.offlineOn: Offline mode is on: no account or API key needed. Models and settings are in the Local tab.
guide.onlineDesc: Free Groq account, the fastest. Steps below.
guide.setup1: Sign in, or create a free account.
guide.setup2: Open “API Keys” and create a new key.
guide.setup3: Copy it into the Online tab → Groq API key.
guide.setup4: Press Test to check the key. It saves itself.
guide.setup5: In the Settings tab, choose the microphone you’ll dictate with.
guide.use1: Click into any text field — chat, email, a document.
guide.use2: Press and hold your shortcut ({shortcut}) and speak.
guide.use3: Release — your words are typed in automatically.
guide.use4: Pick a style in Prompts (Clean, Email, Chat, To Do List) to shape the text.

personal.desc: Your names, terms, and what you dictate about. Used twice: Whisper leans on it while listening, and every AI mode treats it as the spelling authority. Write words and context, not commands — instructions belong in a custom mode.
personal.label: Personal preferences
personal.placeholder:
I want to check this and then make the change.
My name is Alex, I work on a mobile app for cyclists.
Figma, Xcode, TestFlight, sprint, standup

raw.desc: No LLM — paste the transcript as-is. Fastest.

rewrite.desc: Rewrite the dictated text with better clarity. Full-control — may rephrase freely.
rewrite.title: Rewrite

section.desc: After Whisper transcribes, the app rewrites the text using the selected mode. Clean, Email and Chat keep a safety guard so the AI never answers your dictation; Rewrite and Assistant are full-control. Every mode except Raw adds an AI pass.
section.label: Text processing
